name: @calternal/mockup
description: The mockup lane: a fixture-only, server-less app for judging and refining the look and motion of apps before they are built. It reuses packages/ui and copies what it needs; it depends on no plugin package.

scripts.build: npm run check:chrome && npm run tokens && npm run assets && vite build
scripts.dev: npm run tokens && npm run assets && vite
